turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
do I use it properly the very first time?
12:13
DreamCloud Bot
•
AI Agent

For the first time, ensure your DreamCloud mattress is placed on a suitable bed base that can support its weight and user(s). If using a slatted base, ensure gaps are no wider than 9cm and slats are at least 5cm wide. Do not use it on the floor. Always use a mattress protector. You should also rotate your mattress end-to-end weekly for the first three months. Do not jump or stand on the mattress.
